meta.title: Add Memory Bucket Optimizer Tool
meta.body_summary: Add a tool to analyze wolfSSL memory allocation patterns and recommend optimal static memory bucket configurations to minimize wasted overhead, with visualization and WOLFSSL_NO_MALLOC testing support.

perf_labels.notes: Devin delivered a memory bucket optimizer but the algorithm missed large allocation sizes, causing potential failures; maintainer demonstrated incorrect output with a concrete example, and the PR was closed after inactivity without a fix.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 7784 changed lines, this is a large addition of a new tool directory with many files. As a new feature performance PR, it was closed — not merged — because the core optimizer logic was incorrect and the maintainer rejected it.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer JacobBarthelmeh showed that the optimizer output excluded necessary large bucket sizes (e.g., 8368 bytes), causing a WOLFSSL object creation to likely fail, and requested verification with WOLFSSL_NO_MALLOC.
review_details.performance_claim: Analyze malloc sizes and suggest optimal bucket configurations to minimize wasted memory overhead.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer provided concrete example of incorrect bucket recommendations; Devin made follow-up commits addressing directory arguments but did not fix the core optimizer bug; PR auto-closed after 7+ days of inactivity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Memory bucket optimization for wolfSSL’s static memory feature requires precise allocation size analysis; Devin’s tool missed critical large allocations, indicating algorithmic limitations in this domain.

detection_detail.code_reading: JacobBarthelmeh reviewed the optimizer output and identified a missing bucket size (8368 bytes) that would cause a WOLFSSL context creation failure.
detection_detail.manual_testing: The maintainer manually tested the generated output with a TLS 1.3 Google connection and verified the missing bucket, demanding WOLFSSL_NO_MALLOC verification.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Maintainer provided a concrete output file showing the missing bucket size, but no formal benchmark or automated reproducer was included in the PR.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the correctness feedback, Devin added commits to accept wolfSSL directory as argument and added WOLFSSL_NO_MALLOC testing scripts, but the fundamental optimizer bug was not addressed. The bot closed the PR due to inactivity after 7 days.

core_change_summary.description: Added a memory bucket optimizer tool in staticmemory/memory-bucket-optimizer/ with C source (memory_bucket_optimizer.c), shell scripts (run_optimizer.sh, test_operations.sh, etc.), Makefiles, gnuplot visualization scripts, and documentation. The tool analyzes wolfSSL allocation logs and outputs optimized WOLFMEM_BUCKETS and WOLFMEM_DIST macros.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Numerous commits added documentation, fixed paths, added WOLFSSL_NO_MALLOC test scripts, but the core algorithmic flaw in the optimizer remained unaddressed.
change_trajectory: Initial large commit adding the optimizer tool with C code, scripts, and documentation.
Series of commits to add TLS example, test operations, memory comparison script, visualization updates, and path fixes.
After maintainer feedback, added directory argument support and WOLFSSL_NO_MALLOC testing.
No commit addressed the missing bucket size issue; PR closed by inactivity bot.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot posted a PR overview summarizing the ReactFlow migration with no inline comments. (This review is likely misplaced and not relevant to the optimizer; it may be a data anomaly.)
Commented that the optimizer results are not correct; included an example output where a required 8368-byte bucket was missing, and requested verification with WOLFSSL_NO_MALLOC.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin made subsequent commits to address directory arguments and add testing, but did not fix the core optimizer bug; PR eventually closed.

review_signals.summary: Requested that generate_test_logs.sh use a passed-in argument for the wolfSSL directory instead of a hardcoded path, and apply the same to other scripts.
review_signals.action_taken: Commit 6aa87008 updated all scripts to accept the directory as an argument.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI assistance for write-access users.
Closing due to inactivity for more than 7 days.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with initial optimizer tool.
Maintainer JacobBarthelmeh reviewed, provided concrete counterexample of incorrect output, and requested directory argument change.
Devin pushed commits to add directory argument and WOLFSSL_NO_MALLOC testing, but did not correct the bucket selection logic.
Bot auto-closed the PR after 7 days of no further activity (~229.8h total).
